units.title: Eight-argument ABI boundary
units.scope: Unsigned weighted sum across register and stack argument locations.
units.remaining_evidence: Aggregate returns, red-zone rules, other data models and written ABI analysis remain.
steps: Implement abi.c mi_mix with modulo arithmetic
inspect caller and callee disassembly and annotate the seventh/eighth argument addresses
change the last stack-passed argument and predict the result
checks: Zero, UINT64_MAX and independent seventh/eighth arguments

references.purpose: Unsigned weighted sum across register and stack argument locations.

claims.scope: Unsigned weighted sum across register and stack argument locations.

units.title: Assembly under a hostile caller
units.scope: x86-64 SysV assembly uint32 array sum with callee-saved-register sentinels.
units.remaining_evidence: Unwind annotations, floating-point ABI comparison and independent adversarial callers remain.
steps: Implement sum.S without touching inaccessible memory for zero count
annotate register ownership and stack alignment at the call
deliberately clobber one preserved register and retain its rejection trace

references.locator: §3.2.1 Registers and the Stack Frame; §3.2.2 The Stack Frame
references.purpose: x86-64 SysV assembly uint32 array sum with callee-saved-register sentinels.

claims.scope: x86-64 SysV assembly uint32 array sum with callee-saved-register sentinels.

predict both link orders before comparing diagnostics

units.title: Relocation to a shared object
units.scope: A pointer-bearing PIC object is relocated and observed through a real shared object.

locate the relocation entry before linking
explain the resolved address and absence of TEXTREL
checks: Pointer is non-null and points to the actual exported object

units.title: Linker-enforced storage budget

compare section file size and runtime extent
change the ceiling and justify the resulting admission decision
checks: over-budget object rejects with the specified assertion diagnostic

units.title: Entry stack to explicit exit
units.scope: A real no-libc x86-64 Linux entry captures the original stack and terminates by syscall.
units.remaining_evidence: Environment/auxv decoding, CRT inventory and startup debugger evidence remain.

draw initial and aligned stack addresses
run with changed arguments and explain the nonzero rejection exit
checks: argc and two strings must agree
no interpreter, NEEDED or undefined symbols

handle interrupted writes and preserve exact accepted progress
capture raw output and compare the complete 4096-byte sequence
checks: final ELF has no external runtime
